    BO13a Lemma 5 a) when the next long morphism is the quotient morphism #

    If the next long morphism τ = ρ (p+L+1) is itself the morphism we quotient by, the top state of the propagation cannot use the whole rest of a contour path of τ. Following BO13a, take a prefix v₁ of a contour path through which σ (p+L) factors, maximal (realized here by induction on the length of the rest v₂); Lemma 4 c) shows v₂ has length at least two, and the state uses v₂ without its last arrow (RayQuiver.MulBasis.lemma5a_top).
